context: Crime news: Sakura and Ren on a prevention plan.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: crime news; safety vocabulary (犯罪/措置/弁護士/裁判/訴訟) in natural home.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 市は、犯罪を減らす計画を発表しました。
lines.en: The city announced a plan to reduce crime.
lines.style: crisp adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: どんな措置が、取られるんですか?
lines.style: measured young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 見回りを増やす措置が、中心です。
lines.en: Increased patrols are the central measure.
lines.style: clear adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 弁護士は、この計画をどう見ますか?
lines.en: How do lawyers view this plan?
lines.style: curious young commentator voice, soft warm analytical calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ある弁護士は、権利への配慮を求めました。
lines.en: One lawyer called for regard for rights.
lines.style: professional adult anchor voice, soft warm clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 行き過ぎると、訴訟も起きかねませんね。
lines.en: If it goes too far, lawsuits could arise.
lines.style: analytical young commentator voice, soft warm calm throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 裁判で争われた例も、過去にあります。
lines.en: There are past cases contested in court.
lines.style: measured adult anchor voice, soft warm professional clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 犯罪の防止と権利、両立が大切ですね。
lines.en: Balancing crime prevention and rights matters.
lines.style: earnest young commentator voice, soft warm calm closing throughout
